title: 货币简史
lead: 从实物、金属、可兑换纸币到信用货币，每一次切换都源于信任载体的变化。
leadEn: From commodities to metal, convertible notes and fiat money, each switch followed a change in what carries trust.

points.v: 贝壳、盐、白银、黄金因稀缺与易分割而被选为货币。
points.vEn: Shells, salt, silver and gold were chosen for scarcity and divisibility.

points.v: 钱庄与银行发行的票据，承诺可换金属，降低了携带成本。
points.vEn: Bank notes promising metal on demand cut the cost of carrying value.

points.v: 固定兑换限制了政策空间，大萧条与战争迫使各国相继脱钩。
points.vEn: Fixed convertibility limited policy space; depression and war pushed countries off it.

points.v: 价值来自国家信用与法定清偿地位，货币政策获得更大空间，也承担更大责任。
points.vEn: Value rests on state credibility and legal tender status: more policy room, and more responsibility.

watch: 「货币必须有内在价值」是一种常见直觉，但现代货币的锚是制度与预期，而非金属。
超发摧毁货币信用有大量历史案例，因此央行独立性被视为关键制度安排。
watchEn: 'Money must have intrinsic value' is intuitive but modern money is anchored by institutions and expectations, not metal.
History is full of currencies destroyed by over-issuance, which is why central bank independence matters.

sources.label: 米什金《货币金融学》
sources.labelEn: Mishkin, The Economics of Money, Banking and Financial Markets

title: 央行工具箱
lead: 政策利率、公开市场操作、准备金要求与资产购买，是调节货币条件的主要工具。
leadEn: Policy rates, open market operations, reserve requirements and asset purchases are the main levers.

points.v: 最常用的信号工具，直接改变短端资金价格。
points.vEn: The most used signal, directly moving the price of short-term funds.

points.v: 买卖证券调节银行体系流动性，让市场利率贴近目标。
points.vEn: Buying and selling securities to keep market rates near target.

points.v: 准备金率、资本缓冲、贷款价值比等工具直接约束信贷扩张。
points.vEn: Reserve ratios, capital buffers and loan-to-value caps directly constrain credit growth.

points.v: 利率触底后压降长端利率，并用沟通管理预期。
points.vEn: With rates at the floor, buying assets pushes long yields down while communication steers expectations.

watch: 央行面对的是「物价稳定」与「金融稳定」的潜在冲突：长期低利率可能催生资产泡沫。
可信度是政策效力的一部分：市场相信央行，紧缩所需的幅度就更小。
watchEn: Central banks face a tension between price stability and financial stability: prolonged low rates can breed bubbles.
Credibility is part of policy power: if markets believe the bank, less tightening is needed.

sources.label: BIS 年度经济报告 央行工具章节
sources.labelEn: BIS Annual Economic Report, central bank tools

title: 利率体系
lead: 从政策利率到货币市场利率、国债收益率、信贷利率，构成一条层层加价的传导链。
leadEn: From the policy rate to money-market rates, government yields and lending rates, rates form a chain of mark-ups.

points.v: 通常以国债收益率为基准，是其他资产定价的锚。
points.vEn: Usually the government yield, the anchor for pricing other assets.

points.v: 期限越长不确定性越大，投资者要求额外补偿，形成上倾曲线。
points.vEn: Longer maturities carry more uncertainty, so investors demand extra compensation, sloping the curve up.

points.v: 违约风险越高，借款利率相对无风险利率的加点越大。
points.vEn: Higher default risk means a larger spread over the risk-free rate.

points.v: 短借长贷是银行盈利模式，也是流动性风险的根源。
points.vEn: Borrowing short and lending long is the banking business model and the root of liquidity risk.

watch: 收益率曲线倒挂常被当作衰退前兆，但它只是概率信号，不是必然预言。
「实际利率」才影响真实决策：名义利率 5% 而通胀 6%，实际是负利率。
watchEn: An inverted yield curve is often read as a recession signal, but it is a probability, not a prophecy.
Real rates drive real decisions: 5% nominal with 6% inflation is a negative real rate.

sources.label: 美联储 H.15 利率统计说明
sources.labelEn: US Federal Reserve H.15 selected interest rates

title: 银行如何创造货币
lead: 银行不是把存款贷出去，而是「先放贷、后创存款」，货币因此内生扩张。
leadEn: Banks do not lend out deposits; they lend first and create the deposit, so money expands endogenously.

points.v: 发放贷款时同时在借款人账户记账，货币总量随即增加。
points.vEn: Making a loan simultaneously credits the borrower's account, so the money stock rises.

points.v: 准备金与资本充足率限制扩张上限，但通常不是日常最紧的约束。
points.vEn: Reserves and capital ratios cap expansion but are rarely the binding constraint day to day.

points.v: 教科书以准备金率倒推乘数，现实中受信贷需求与银行风险偏好影响。
points.vEn: Textbooks derive a multiplier from reserve ratios; in practice credit demand and bank risk appetite dominate.

points.v: 非银机构承担信用中介功能，扩张了货币与信用，也带来监管盲区。
points.vEn: Non-bank intermediaries extend credit and money, expanding both and creating regulatory blind spots.

watch: 「存款来自储蓄」是常见的直觉错误：在信用货币体系中，贷款先创造存款。
信贷扩张与资产价格相互强化，是理解金融周期与危机的关键机制。
watchEn: 'Deposits come from savings' is a common intuition error: in a credit-money system lending creates deposits first.
Credit expansion and asset prices reinforce each other, the key mechanism behind financial cycles.

sources.label: 英格兰银行《现代经济中的货币创造》
sources.labelEn: Bank of England, Money creation in the modern economy

title: 汇率制度
lead: 固定、浮动与有管理的浮动各有利弊，核心权衡是「稳定」与「政策自主」不可兼得。
leadEn: Fixed, floating and managed floats trade off stability against policy autonomy.

points.v: 锚定他国货币，降低贸易与投资不确定性，但需消耗外储并让渡货币政策。
points.vEn: Pegging to another currency reduces trade uncertainty but costs reserves and monetary autonomy.

points.v: 由市场决定，货币政策独立，但汇率波动增加企业风险管理成本。
points.vEn: Market-determined rates preserve policy independence but raise hedging costs for firms.

points.v: 以市场为主、必要时干预，实践中大多数经济体处于这一区间。
points.vEn: Mostly market-driven with occasional intervention: where most economies actually sit.

points.v: 资本自由流动、固定汇率、独立货币政策，三者最多同时实现两个。
points.vEn: Free capital flows, a fixed rate and independent policy: at most two of the three.

watch: 「操纵汇率」在国际规则中需具体证据界定，不宜作为泛化指控。
外储规模决定干预能力上限，耗尽后往往被迫一次性重估。
watchEn: 'Currency manipulation' requires specific evidence under international rules and should not be a blanket accusation.
Reserves cap intervention capacity; depletion often forces a one-off revaluation.

sources.label: IMF 汇率安排与汇率限制年报
sources.labelEn: IMF Annual Report on Exchange Arrangements and Exchange Restrictions

title: 泡沫与危机
lead: 泡沫的典型配方是宽松资金 + 新叙事 + 杠杆 + 错配，破裂则通过资产负债表传染。
leadEn: Bubbles typically combine easy money, a new story, leverage and mismatch; the crash spreads through balance sheets.

points.v: 低利率、金融创新、新叙事（新技术/新市场）与羊群行为共同推高价格。
points.vEn: Low rates, financial innovation, a new story and herding push prices up together.

points.v: 资产价格下跌触发追缴保证金与抛售，抵押品价值下降压缩信贷。
points.vEn: Falling prices trigger margin calls and selling; collateral values drop and credit contracts.

points.v: 降息、流动性支持、担保与资本注入，优先阻断系统性传染。
points.vEn: Rate cuts, liquidity support, guarantees and recapitalisation aim to stop systemic contagion.

points.v: 去杠杆导致长期低增长与失业上升，恢复往往以年计。
points.vEn: Deleveraging brings prolonged weak growth and higher unemployment; recovery takes years.

watch: 「识别泡沫」在事前极难：事后看似明显，事前与「基本面改善」难以区分。
宏观审慎工具的作用是降低破裂后果，而不是精确戳破泡沫。
watchEn: Identifying bubbles ex ante is extremely hard: ex post they look obvious, ex ante they resemble improving fundamentals.
Macroprudential tools aim to soften the aftermath, not to precisely prick bubbles.

title: 支付与清算体系
lead: 钱的本体是记账：支付体系决定谁欠谁、何时结清，是现代经济的血管。
leadEn: Money is bookkeeping at heart: the payments system decides who owes whom and when it settles—the economy's circulatory system.

points.v: 日常扫码/刷卡走零售支付，银行间大额走批发系统实时总额结算。
points.vEn: Everyday QR/card payments ride rails; interbank large transfers use real-time gross settlement.

points.v: 先算清应收应付（清算），再完成资金最终转移（结算），时点差产生风险。
points.vEn: First net out claims (clearing), then make the final transfer (settlement); the lag between them creates risk.

points.v: 央行大额系统与卡组织构成关键基础设施，宕机即系统性风险。
points.vEn: Central-bank rails and card networks are critical infrastructure; an outage is systemic risk.

points.v: 多层代理行与报文系统使跨境支付慢、贵、不透明。
points.vEn: Chains of correspondent banks and messaging make cross-border payment slow, costly and opaque.

watch: 支付即时化降低信用风险，却要求更高的流动性管理与技术韧性。
数据与入口集中使科技巨头成为新的系统重要性节点。
watchEn: Faster settlement cuts credit risk but demands tighter liquidity management and resilience.
Concentrated data and access make tech giants new systemically important nodes.

sources.label: BIS 支付、清算与市场基础设施体系
sources.labelEn: BIS CPSS principles for financial market infrastructures

title: 数字货币与稳定币
lead: 从现金到银行存款再到代币，货币形态在变，信任与记账的核心未变。
leadEn: From cash to bank deposits to tokens: the form of money changes, but trust and bookkeeping remain the core.

points.v: 央行数字货币是零售央行的直接负债，兼顾效率与监管，但涉隐私与金融脱媒。
points.vEn: A central-bank digital currency is a direct central-bank liability—efficient yet raising privacy and disintermediation concerns.

points.v: 去中心化记账与无国界，但波动大、能耗高、多用于投机而非支付。
points.vEn: Decentralized and borderless, yet volatile, energy-hungry and used more for speculation than payment.

points.v: 挂钩法币以求稳定，靠储备资产兑付，挤兑与储备不透明是隐患。
points.vEn: Pegged to fiat for stability and redeemed via reserves; runs and opaque reserves are the risk.

points.v: 广泛美元化稳定币削弱弱币国政策空间，推动各国加快自研。
points.vEn: Widespread dollar-pegged stablecoins erode weak-currency policy space, spurring homegrown projects.

watch: 可编程性与可控匿名之间的张力，是 CBDC 设计最难权衡之处。
多数数字资产仍受传统金融监管，‘去中心化’并不等于免于监管。
watchEn: Balancing programmability against controllable anonymity is CBDC's hardest design trade-off.
Most digital assets remain under conventional finance rules; 'decentralized' is not 'unregulated'.

title: 影子银行与期限错配
lead: 在监管银行体系之外，同样在做借贷与转换期限的事，却少有安全网支撑。
leadEn: Outside the regulated banking system lies lending and maturity transformation with fewer backstops.

points.v: 货币基金、理财、同业、担保债务凭证等执行类银行功能而不受同等监管。
points.vEn: Money funds, wealth-management products, interbank and structured credit act bank-like without equal regulation.

points.v: 期限错配、流动性错配与高杠杆，一旦信心动摇就会挤兑式抛售。
points.vEn: Maturity, liquidity mismatch and high leverage—shake confidence and runs turn into fire sales.

points.v: 活动向监管更松处迁移，规则漏洞使风险隐蔽积累。
points.vEn: Activity migrates to looser rules; gaps let risk build out of sight.

points.v: 与银行高度互联，使影子部门的风暴反噬正规体系。
points.vEn: Deep links to banks let a shadow storm rebound onto the regulated system.

watch: 2008 年危机大量肇因于影子部门，宏观审慎将监管扩展到银行以外。
“大而不倒”之外还有“密而不倒”：互联度本身也是系统性风险源。
watchEn: The 2008 crisis owed much to the shadow sector; macroprudential oversight widened beyond banks.
Beyond 'too big to fail' lies 'too interconnected to fail'.

sources.label: FSB 全球影子银行监测报告
sources.labelEn: FSB Global Shadow Banking Monitoring Report

title: 存款保险与安全网
lead: 为存款兜底能防挤兑，却也会鼓励银行冒险，这就是安全网的两难。
leadEn: Backstop deposits and you prevent runs but invite risk-taking—that is the safety-net dilemma.

points.v: 银行天然面临“先取先得”博弈，保险打破自我实现式挤兑。
points.vEn: Banks face a first-come-first-served game; insurance breaks self-fulfilling runs.

points.v: 储户不再监督银行、银行敢于加风险，需以审慎监管与资本要求对冲。
points.vEn: Depositors stop monitoring and banks take risk—offset by prudential rules and capital.

points.v: 限额保险保留部分市场纪律，全额保护更稳但道德风险更大。
points.vEn: A cap preserves some discipline; full cover is steadier but riskier in behavior.

points.v: 央行向健康但遭挤兑的机构注入流动性，与保险共同构成安全网。
points.vEn: The central bank lends to sound-but-run-out institutions, forming the backstop with insurance.

watch: 保护上限与赔付速度决定了恐慌时市场能否真正稳定。
安全网不可免费：成本以保费、财政风险与潜在通胀方式分摊。
watchEn: The coverage cap and payout speed decide whether panic truly stabilizes.
The backstop isn't free: it costs premiums, fiscal risk and possible inflation.

sources.label: FDIC《监管改革》；戴蒙德—迪布维格模型
